explication: Hermes Workspace is a self-hosted AI-agent command center: a user works through a browser or desktop workspace, which exposes chat, sessions, files, memory, skills and operational controls over a local API to Hermes services. Chat is the central interaction; separate screens support agent orchestration, swarm dispatch, task tracking, dashboards, MCP and terminal work. The README documents these product capabilities and the gateway/dashboard split. The sampled excerpts show task and MCP-source interactions, but not most route handlers or service wiring, so uncertain internal links are omitted.
